Anika Patel: quick heads-up — Nimbus Health showing sticky issues: WAU down 37% week-over-week, trial-to-paid drop at onboarding step 3.
CS Ops Bot: Risk score for NIMBUS-42 updated to 82 (high). Signals: low api calls, billing contact bounce, docs viewed but no repeat logins.
Anika Patel: I want to propose an "adhesion play" we can run this week. short checklist below, assigning owners.
Sam Ortega: I'll own the AM outreach. Scheduling availability: Mon/Tue morning. will try a 15-min 'scope & blockers' call first.
Leo Chen: I'll prep a 20-min focused enablement session on the two blocked flows (model routing & key rotations). Slide deck + 10-min Q&A.
Maya Rivera: Support can scope a quick health-check runbook and check for config drift. Tagging @Ben for docs snippets.
Ben (CSE): I'll provide a targeted "sticky-path" quickstart and a one-click sample repo link. Draft email template:
```
Subject: Quick sync + checklist to get Nimbus to X
Hi <Name>,
Quick note — noticed some usage drops. Can we hop on a 15-min call to unblock? I've attached a 3-step checklist to restore throughput.
Thanks, Sam
```
Anika Patel: Handoff plan: Sam does call, Leo runs enablement, Maya triages infra, Ben publishes short guide. Goal: prevent downgrade/exit before renewal (30 days).
Sam Ortega: I'll log outcome in the account card and add follow-ups to the renewal play. Ping me if you want to join the call.
Leo Chen: Will also include a mini A/B of a caching tweak we can flip in sandbox to show immediate latency improvements.
Maya Rivera: If we find a config bug, we'll target a hotfix and mark as P0 in the support queue.
CS Ops Bot: Created task CS-8942 and linked to NIMBUS-42. Assigned: Sam, Leo, Maya, Ben.
Anika Patel: Thanks all — let's reconvene after the call. :thumbsup:
